title: LocalFlow M12 adversarial corpus
execution_statement: No corpus case, native check, performance run or mutant was executed by the GPT audit. This is a machine-readable driver/oracle specification, not an executable test runner.
source_policy: Synthetic fixtures only. Use owned helper windows, private pasteboards, temporary stores and a temporary outside-sentinel directory; never Daniel’s data or active apps.
case_status_policy: Every case, metamorphic relation and mutation definition remains NOT_RUN. Local execution must produce a separate result file and preserve this supplied corpus byte-identical.
word_coordinate_policy: Text ranges are half-open Unicode code-point offsets. Native UTF-16 conversion is explicit. Origin spans use the documented whitespace-split word convention, not grapheme or linguistic-token indices.

finding_register.title: Persisted attachment paths can escape managed filesystem authority
Export can destroy pre-existing destination files and leave untracked partial writes
A failed outgoing flush does not prevent discarding the dirty editor
Attribution offsets use the persisted parent instead of the dirty pre-arrival buffer
Attachment and note deletion perform irreversible unlinks before SQL commit
Attachment creation lacks live-note admission and treats unknown commit outcome as rollback
Dictation and transform success are published before the note revision commits
Flush workers are untracked and a concurrent flush call is not a durability barrier
The buffer and single pending attribution slot are not captured atomically
Autosave timer is registered under the literal mode "default"
Scratchpad actions mix selected state with an older rendered editor binding
The native caret’s UTF-16 location is used as a Python code-point index
Whole-note transform acceptance accepts an unchanged prefix after the note grows
History transfer bypasses the repaired final-stage and current-attempt resolver
Deleting a note does not revoke its retained transform copies or fence late candidate publication
Note evidence callbacks are neither revision-idempotent nor fenced by note deletion
Ambiguous repeated-word alignment can transfer dictated provenance to typed text
An older save can clear the dirty marker for a newer unsaved generation
A refused note destination writes to the clipboard without the recovery action being chosen
History Move-to-Scratchpad calls a nonexistent helper
Fixed Scratchpad action geometry extends beyond the available pane
Malformed native ranges are clamped/rounded instead of explicitly refused
Scratchpad refresh rebuilds picker contents without retaining the chosen stable identity
M12 mutation UI reports generic failure for admitted writes with unknown outcomes
The benchmark does not certify its advertised workload or acknowledgment metric
Historical M12 acceptance contains a private absolute working-directory path

policy_decisions_required.D01: Same-note edits, caret-only/nonzero selection and switch-away/reopen after PTT: conservative refusal or validated rebase; record exact authority policy before grading policy-dependent outcomes.
policy_decisions_required.D02: Restore parents writer-current revision or refuses an explicitly stale action; preserve dirty buffers and define flush completion.
policy_decisions_required.D03: Historically merged attributed arrivals: adjudicate against exact provenance; this audit recommends ordered immutable per-arrival ownership.
policy_decisions_required.D04: Whitespace-word spans and mid-word heuristic: never overstate certainty or label unrelated typed content as dictated.
policy_decisions_required.D05: Full-content revision growth and retention/coalescing remain outside narrow repair absent measured necessity.
policy_decisions_required.D06: Explicit export collision/unused-attachment policy and user-managed-copy deletion boundary; internal derived artifacts are not user-managed exports.
